tasks.title: Run all tests and verify they pass
tasks.description:
Execute the complete test suite using 'npm test' command. Verify that:
1. All test files run successfully: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
2. The test command exits with code 0
3. No test failures or errors are reported
4. All assertions pass

If any tests fail, report the specific failures with error messages and stack traces.
acceptance_criteria: npm test command exits with code 0
